origin.title: Origin
origin.description: The protagonist's origin — their starting attribute and three trained abilities.

markers.title: Reputation Markers
markers.description: Markers are visible to everyone — simply present or absent, each with the reason it was acquired.

species.title: Species
species.description: This character's species — Human or Fey in ordinary project metadata. Optional player-character classification.

abilities.title: Trained Abilities
abilities.description: Start with the origin's three abilities. The GM may award additional abilities during play.

archetypes.title: Archetypes
archetypes.description: Every applicable archetype — provenance, pattern, fey-role, profession, title, or social identity. Stored explicitly and flat; never inferred from indirect chains.

attributes.title: Attribute Dice
attributes.description: Each attribute is a dice pool of 1-5 d6s; every 4+ is a success. The protagonist's origin attribute starts at 3, the rest at 2.

myBargains.title: My Bargains
myBargains.expression: ($self.knownBargains ?? []).filter(b => ($self.signedBargains ?? []).some(s => load(s)?.$name === load(b)?.$name)).filter(b => !($self.bargainFilters?.myOnlyActive == true) || (load(b)?.status ?? '') === 'active').map(b => ({ bargain: b, name: load(b)?.name ?? '', status: load(b)?.status ?? '' }))
myBargains.description: Known bargains the player is a party to, optionally filtered to active only, for display.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Signed balance change: positive credits the character, negative debits the character.

reason.title: Exact reason
reason.description: Explains whether this entry was a payment, an exchange, a penalty, or a debt.

graceLedger.title: Grace Ledger
graceLedger.description: Authoritative record of every Grace gain or loss. Balances are derived from this ledger — never maintain a separate running total. Negative amounts are Grace debt.

graceBalances.title: Grace Balances
graceBalances.expression: { "queens-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Queen's Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "phantom-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Phantom Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "seelie-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Seelie Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "spring-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Spring Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "summer-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Summer Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "autumn-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Autumn Graces"), e => number(e.amount)), "winter-graces": sum(($self.graceLedger ?? []).filter(e => load(e.currency)?.$name === "Winter Graces"), e => number(e.amount)) }
graceBalances.description: Current balance of each Grace currency, derived by summing the signed amounts in the grace ledger for that currency. Never maintain a separate running total.

hasMyBargains.title: Has My Bargains
hasMyBargains.description: True when there is at least one bargain to show on the 'My bargains' sub-tab.

knownBargains.title: Known Bargains
knownBargains.description: Bargains the player is currently aware of. The GM adds references here as the player learns about bargains.

otherBargains.title: Other Bargains
otherBargains.expression: ($self.knownBargains ?? []).filter(b => !(($self.signedBargains ?? []).some(s => load(s)?.$name === load(b)?.$name))).filter(b => !($self.bargainFilters?.otherOnlyActive == true) || (load(b)?.status ?? '') === 'active').map(b => ({ bargain: b, name: load(b)?.name ?? '', status: load(b)?.status ?? '' }))
otherBargains.description: Known bargains the player is NOT a party to, optionally filtered to active only, for display.

bargainFilters.title: Bargain Filters

myOnlyActive.title: My only active
myOnlyActive.description: Only show active bargains on the 'My bargains' sub-tab.

otherOnlyActive.title: Other only active
otherOnlyActive.description: Only show active bargains on the 'Other bargains' sub-tab.

bargainFilters.description: State of the 'Only active bargains' toggles on the two Bargains sub-tabs (My / Other).

conditionState.title: Condition State

maximum.title: Maximum
maximum.description: The currently applicable Effective Maximum after outfit, environmental, and situational modifiers.

depletion.title: Depletion
depletion.description: Accumulated damage, fatigue, strain, embarrassment, or exposure that remains when Maximum changes.

maximum.description: The currently applicable Effective Maximum after outfit, environmental, and situational modifiers.

depletion.title: Depletion
depletion.description: Accumulated damage, fatigue, strain, embarrassment, or exposure that remains when Maximum changes.

conditionState.description: Stored state for the five Condition Tracks. Missing values compute as Maximum 3 and Depletion 0.

signedBargains.title: Signed Bargains
signedBargains.description: Bargains the player is a party to (their own contracts/obligations). The GM maintains this alongside knownBargains.

conditionTracks.title: Condition Tracks
conditionTracks.expression: [{ key: 'health', name: 'Health', family: 'persistent', maximum: clamp($self.conditionState?.health?.maximum ?? 3, 0, 3), depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.health?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'wakefulness', name: 'Wakefulness', family: 'persistent', maximum: clamp($self.conditionState?.wakefulness?.maximum ?? 3, 0, 3), depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.wakefulness?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'composure', name: 'Composure', family: 'persistent', maximum: clamp($self.conditionState?.composure?.maximum ?? 3, 0, 3), depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.composure?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'decorum', name: 'Decorum', family: 'scene', maximum: clamp($self.conditionState?.decorum?.maximum ?? 3, 0, 3), depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.decorum?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }, { key: 'concealment', name: 'Concealment', family: 'scene', maximum: clamp($self.conditionState?.concealment?.maximum ?? 3, 0, 3), depletion: clamp($self.conditionState?.concealment?.depletion ?? 0, 0, 3) }].map(t => ({ key: t.key, name: t.name, family: t.family, maximum: t.maximum, depletion: t.depletion, current: clamp(t.maximum - t.depletion, 0, 3) }))
conditionTracks.description: Derived Condition Tracks — five fixed rows (Health, Wakefulness, Composure, Decorum, Concealment). Current is always derived from Maximum and Depletion; it is never stored.

outfitModifiers.title: Worn Outfit Condition Modifiers
outfitModifiers.description: Condition modifiers of the currently worn outfit.

hasOtherBargains.title: Has Other Bargains
hasOtherBargains.description: True when there is at least one bargain to show on the 'Other bargains' sub-tab.

outfitDescription.title: Worn Outfit Description
outfitDescription.description: Description of the currently worn outfit.

graceLedgerDisplay.title: Grace Ledger Display
graceLedgerDisplay.expression: ($self.graceLedger ?? []).map(e => ({ day: number(e.day), amountDisplay: (number(e.amount) >= 0 ? '+' : '') + number(e.amount) + (load(e.currency)?.symbol ?? ''), reason: e.reason }))
graceLedgerDisplay.description: Formatted grace ledger rows: each amount as a signed number followed by its currency's symbol (e.g. +1000🍀). Derived from the ledger and each Grace currency's symbol.
